_about: Run and fitness clubs in the Burlington area (Burlington, Winooski, South Burlington, Essex, Williston, Shelburne, Colchester) with the days and places they meet. Read by the People tab; checked by scripts/build_run_clubs.py.

VERIFIED means: every fact in an entry was read on the club's OWN page (its website, Meetup group or event page, Instagram bio or post, Facebook page, Strava club, or the host venue's or town's own schedule page) on checked.date, and checked.source is that page's URL, with checked.note quoting what it says. Aggregators (RunGroop, Great Runs, Seven Days listings, Yelp) are leads only. Nothing is guessed: a field the page does not support is left empty.

A meet is a standing WEEKLY slot (same weekday, same time). A club whose day or place changes week to week gets meets: [] and a schedule_note saying where to look. A start point that moves gets where: 'Varies ...' with lat/lng null. Monthly or one-off events never become meets.

To add a club: read its own page, add an entry (id, name, kind, what, meets[{day mon..sun, time 'HH:MM' 24h, where, address, lat, lng, note, optional season}], schedule_note, level, cost, season, newcomers, url, instagram, meetup, strava, checked{date, source, note, optional also[]}), geocode the meeting place to 4 decimals, then run python3 scripts/build_run_clubs.py. It must print OK. Re-read any club the script warns is stale (over 120 days).

kind is one of: run, hike, bike, climb, pickup, yoga, row-paddle, other. Seasonal meets carry season so the tab can say 'summer only' instead of sending people to an empty parking lot. The tab reads the machine fields, never the text: optional months (1-12, the months a meet runs), from and until (YYYY-MM-DD, the first and last day, both kept) and skip (YYYY-MM-DD days with no meet), on the club or on one meet (a meet's months replace the club's; every date on the club and the meet applies). A schedule the page dates (a 2026 series) gets from/until, so it never comes back on its own next year; months are for a club that says it runs every summer. A time that changes partway through a series is two meets with their own from/until. A meet outside them is not on this week's strip. When the page gives only a season word ("summer", "winter"), months take the narrow reading, so nobody is sent to an empty lot.
